name: Research
description: Scope → Gather → Synthesize → Draft → Review, for literature and investigative work.

phases.title: Scope
phases.description: Narrow the research question into an answerable scope.
aiInstructions: Write the research question, sub-questions and exclusions into goals/boundaries of context.json.
Create a gathering task for each sub-question (source types, keywords).

phases.title: Gather
phases.description: Collect sources systematically and keep records.
aiInstructions: Gather material task by task; store sources and excerpts in artifacts/ (with citations).
Quality over quantity; discard unverifiable sources outright and record why.

exitGates.prompt: Coverage is sufficient to answer the research question

phases.title: Synthesize
phases.description: Derive positions and conclusions from the material.
aiInstructions: Cross-check sources; flag conflicts and assess credibility.
Record the core conclusions and their supporting grounds as decisions.

phases.title: Draft
aiInstructions: Produce a fully structured first draft in artifacts/draft.md (introduction, method, findings, conclusion, references).

phases.title: Review
aiInstructions: Verify citations and figures section by section, fix and finalize.
Record the final conclusions as decisions.

exitGates.prompt: Citations verified and final draft confirmed

phases.title: Retrospect
aiInstructions: Answer the flywheel prompts and write the improvements back into rules.json.
